scope: Deterministic comparison and durable audit using caller-supplied captured events; no real-feed agreement claim.
implemented: Builds interval OHLC from same-instrument tick events and compares open, high, low and close with a later Kite historical bar.
Rejects unsupported intervals, unknown historical source tags, same-day retrieval and history available before the compared live ticks.
Logs deterministic per-field deltas, source labels and event hashes in an idempotent durable audit journal.
Disagreement is marked DIVERGENT and remains UNVERIFIED; matching data is also not treated as adjudicated. No series is repaired or overwritten.

tests.result: 15 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed for historical_divergence.py.

limitations: No prospective live tick capture and next-day Kite history sample has been adjudicated; real divergence frequencies and provider-specific behavior remain unknown.
The caller is responsible for loading events through rights-gated archive APIs; source labels alone do not authenticate provider access.
A separate human/data-quality adjudication workflow is not yet connected to clear UNVERIFIED status.
